history.prompt: Extreme close-up macro photograph of a jammed automatic tool changer carousel on a precision milling machine. The heavy steel rotary magazine is overloaded with too many complex titanium cutting heads and intricate drill bits, colliding and wedged together in a chaotic cluster. Visible machine oil, frosted metal surfaces, and gleaming aluminum shavings. 100mm macro lens, one razor-sharp focal plane on the jammed collision point, shallow depth of field with the dark workshop background falling away into soft bokeh. Soft directional daylight, high-texture industrial storytelling.
